description: Read and write Bitbucket Cloud repositories, pull requests, branches, tags, commits, pipelines, source files, workspaces and members on bitbucket.org in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Bitbucket session.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List repositories in a Bitbucket workspace. Supports pagination and filtering with Bitbucket query language.

tools.name: get_repository
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Bitbucket repository.

tools.name: create_repository
tools.description: Create a new repository in a Bitbucket workspace.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests for a Bitbucket repository. By default returns open pull requests. Supports pagination and state filtering.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific pull request.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request in a Bitbucket repository.

tools.name: update_pull_request
tools.description: Update an existing pull request. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge a pull request. Supports merge commit, squash, and fast-forward strategies.

tools.name: decline_pull_request
tools.description: Decline a pull request, marking it as rejected.

tools.name: approve_pull_request
tools.description: Approve a pull request as the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_pr_comments
tools.description: List comments on a pull request. Supports pagination.

tools.name: create_pr_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a pull request.

tools.name: get_pull_request_diff
tools.description: Get the unified diff of all changed files in a pull request.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List branches in a Bitbucket repository. Supports pagination and filtering.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a Bitbucket repository from a commit hash or existing branch name.

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Delete a branch from a Bitbucket repository. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags in a Bitbucket repository. Supports pagination.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List commits in a Bitbucket repository. Optionally filter by branch or tag name. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific commit.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List CI/CD pipelines for a Bitbucket repository. Supports pagination and sorting.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific pipeline run.

tools.name: list_pipeline_steps
tools.description: List steps for a specific pipeline run. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read the raw content of a file from a Bitbucket repository at a given branch, tag, or commit.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search for code across all repositories in a Bitbucket workspace. Returns matching file paths and content snippets.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all Bitbucket workspaces the authenticated user has access to. Supports pagination.

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.description: List all members of a Bitbucket workspace. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Bitbucket user.
